{{Top|leg}}
'''Chrech Estha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] and a respected leader of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Churruma]]'s [[Unidentified Churruma natives|native culture]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Estha was captured on Churruma by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] on the planet [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].
